title: Johnne28 Hub
features:
Johnne28 Hub V1.3 is an extensive, all-in-one script hub built for Roblox that features two main operating modes: a broad Universal mode and a specialized Death in the Box mode. It comes with a sleek graphical interface equipped with multiple color themes, audio feedback, a dynamic search bar, and automatic configuration saving.

For gameplay enhancement, the hub offers robust combat tools like a predictive aimbot, silent aim, triggerbot, and kill aura, paired with Solara-safe visual aids such as 2D boxes, tracers, and bone-mapping ESP. It also packs extensive mobility options like noclip and flight, dedicated vehicle boosting and flying mechanics, and specialized automations for game-specific loops like auto-defusing, auto-sawing, reaction checks, and fire management. To round things out, the script includes fun trolling utilities like a ghost mode freecam, invis-fling, client-side invisibility, and a cosmetic JoJo stand follower, alongside a built-in server player inspector for tracking down players, spectating, and checking stats on the fly.
